annotations.title: Rents by place, Australia and NZ

description: One place by whole name or postcode, no state needed - the only tool for NZ and for ACT and NT postcodes; an NSW, QLD, WA or SA total, an NSW or QLD council, a Victorian region or part of a name is in area_rents or vic_rents. Elsewhere in Australia: as those tools answer it, with their limits, sources and refusals. An NZ council or region: MBIE's median rent of new bonds for one month, in NZ$, provisional, no change on a year. An ACT or NT postcode, or a TAS one with too few bonds: interim ABS cover, not new-bond medians - the 2021 Census rent, the capital's rents index and sale prices, each with its period and flags. A name held in more than one place is listed, not chosen. For questions such as "median rent in Fremantle".

place.description: A suburb, locality, postcode or NZ council; a state may follow ("Richmond, VIC")
